sourcesPage.title: Sources
sourcesPage.intro: Standkreis Atlas combines open biodiversity data instead of maintaining a separate scientific database. Here is what each source contributes and where its limits begin.
sourcesPage.limitsTitle: A source is evidence, not certainty.
sourcesPage.limitsBody: Records can be incomplete, outdated or wrong. Local occurrence is an indication of what has been reported nearby, never a guarantee that a species is present.
sourcesPage.imageNote: Images and sounds can have a different author and licence for every asset. Their exact credit therefore stays attached to the image or recording instead of being replaced by this page.

sources.bkg: Official district regions and land boundaries (31 December 2024). © GeoBasis-DE / BKG (2026), Data Licence Germany – Attribution 2.0 (dl-de/by-2-0). Coordinates transformed and rounded; boundaries not simplified.
sources.gbif: Provides the taxonomic backbone and occurrence records used to assemble regional species lists, seasonal likelihood and maps.
sources.wikidata: Provides identifiers, common names and selected structured facts such as wingspan and fungal characteristics. Data is published under CC0.
sources.wikipedia: Provides the optional background text on species pages. The text keeps Wikipedia's licence and is not independently reviewed by us.
sources.iucn: Provides the conservation categories shown where a matching assessment is available.
sources.avonet: Provides bird body mass, habitat and migration traits. Published under CC BY 4.0.
sources.elton: Provides bird and mammal diet, activity and habitat traits. Published under CC0 1.0.
sources.pantheria: Provides mammal body measurements. The archive does not state a licence; its Figshare wrapper labels the dataset CC BY 4.0.
sources.amphibio: Provides amphibian size, mass, habitat, diet and activity traits. Published under CC BY 4.0.
sources.gift: Provides plant height, flowering period, pollination and life-form traits. The API does not currently state a licence, so the project is named wherever its data is used.
sources.anage: Provides longevity and reproduction values for some animals. Its pages do not state a reusable data licence.
sources.globi: Aggregates published records of ecological interactions. A recorded relationship is evidence from a dataset, not proof of an encounter in your region.
sources.inaturalist: Provides licensed species photographs. The photographer, licence and original page are shown on each image.
sources.commons: Provides freely licensed species photographs. The creator, licence and original file page are shown on each image.
sources.xenoCanto: Provides animal recordings. The recordist, licence and original recording page stay attached to each sound.
sources.anthropic: Provides the optional AI-assisted photo identification. Its suggestion can be wrong and is not a scientific determination.
